Retest FAIL — 10–11 Nov 2026 → moved to Bug
Environment: staging-desk.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge; account: admin. Zoho reference: Zoho Desk (techsolutionsegypt), checked live 11 Nov 2026; Zoho test data deleted afterwards.

CRM blueprint: fixed, and it now matches Zoho CRM (Task has a fixed module, one "Assigned To" where empty means the record owner, and Status/Priority start on the first option). Desk blueprint ("Tickets from Mail"): not fixed.

Working now:

  • CRM Create task / Meeting / Call: no module picker, owner only through Assign to, pick lists start on the first option (same as Zoho CRM)

Still failing:

  • Desk Field update: value of a pick list: expected Zoho Desk: starts at "-None-" and then the real options; actual TAVI shows "Value" as if it were an option
  • Desk Field update: fields offered: expected Zoho Desk does not offer Status, Team, Department or Skills in a blueprint Field update; actual TAVI offers Status and Skills, and Department/Team as plain text "Value"
  • Desk Create task: Department / Team: expected Zoho Desk has no Department/Team boxes; "Assign to" is a picker with Agents and Teams tabs; actual TAVI has Department* and Team as plain text boxes

Correction to the expected result: Zoho Desk does not pick the first real option; it starts at "-None-".

Global Sets work for create, convert, clone, values (add, rename, colour, replace, unused, restore), association with mapping, safeguards and permissions. One gap remains against Zoho CRM.

Working now:

  • Create / convert / clone, values, association + mapping, 50-field limit, locked and wrong-type fields refused, permissions and audit
  • Used In lists fields and custom views (Zoho lists fields only, so the earlier "reports not listed" point is dropped)

Still failing:

  • Replace a value that a custom view filter uses: expected Zoho CRM allows it and replaces the value in records, criteria, workflow actions and field dependency (Green → Red: the lead and the view filter both changed, Green moved to unused); actual TAVI refuses with 409 GLOBAL_SET_VALUE_IN_USE "Change or remove it in those views first"

Environment: staging-crm.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge; account: admin. Zoho reference: Zoho CRM (org944965048, Enterprise), checked live 11 Nov 2026; Zoho test data deleted afterwards.

Mass delete and Recycle Bin selection delete now finish after the user leaves the page. Mass update does not.

Working now:

  • Mass delete of 450 records: finished after leaving the page (0 failed)
  • Recycle Bin: delete 50 selected, leave the page → done (twice)

Still failing:

  • Mass update, leave the page 1 s after starting: expected Zoho CRM runs it as a background job ("The mass update action is scheduled successfully" + progress panel): 200/200 updated within 1 min after leaving; actual TAVI: 6 of 200 changed after 45 s and after 3 min; no job, nothing resumed

Empty Recycle Bin (whole bin) was not run because the bin also holds other people's items.

Environment: staging-crm.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge; account: admin. Zoho reference: Zoho CRM (org944965048, Enterprise), checked live 11 Nov 2026; Zoho test data deleted afterwards.

A failed send is now recorded honestly (422 MAIL_SEND_FAILED, Emails tab "Not sent… Failed" + Retry, no Email sent entry in the timeline). The screen still lets a sender who can't send try.

Working now:

  • Send from a refused sender → 422, Emails tab Failed + Retry, no EmailSent in the timeline (both cases)

Still failing:

  • Compose when the sender can't send: expected Zoho CRM blocks Send Email before Compose opens ("Email Confirmation Required … so that you can send emails"); actual TAVI opens Compose with no notice and Send enabled, although /emails/sendability already says can_send false
  • Message dialog of a failed mail: expected Only the failed status; actual TAVI shows a blue "Sent" chip next to the red "Failed" chip

How Zoho shows a failed send on the record was not compared (that needs a real failing send to an outside address).

Deleting a synced contact in Desk now unlinks it without a failure, and records in the Desk recycle bin are counted as Ignored. Deletions on the CRM side are still reported as failures.

Working now:

  • Delete in Desk → link unlinked, no failure
  • Sync all customers: Desk-deleted records counted as Ignored

Still failing:

  • Contact deleted in CRM: expected Unlinked and left out, not reported as a failure (ticket); actual Failure Log "Needs attention · The CRM record was deleted."; the Desk contact stays
  • Sync all customers: expected No failure for records that exist in neither app; actual 1 failure "B04" (Last Name empty), a record in neither customer list

Not compared with Zoho: testing deletions would need writes in both Zoho apps; judged against the ticket's expected result.

First page of the list is still far above the 1.5 s target, with slow outliers that Zoho does not have.

Still failing:

  • Leads list, first page (navigation → first real row): expected Target p95 ≤ 1.5 s; Zoho CRM measured the same way: 6.7–8.0 s (median 7.46 s), no outliers; actual TAVI Leads p50 4.28 s, p95 13.53 s; Transactions p95 9.15 s and 19.92 s on two runs

TAVI's median is faster than Zoho's, but its p95 (13.5–19.9 s) is well above Zoho's slowest load (8.0 s) and the 1.5 s target.
